cmp_server_url.title: ONE Central Monitoring Platform (CMP) Server URL
cmp_server_url.description: Base HTTPS URL of the Central Monitoring Platform API (e.g., https://cmp.district.edu:8000)

api_key.title: Sensor Fleet API Key
api_key.description: Enrollment or Sensor API key for authenticated metric submission to CMP

campus_id.title: Campus Identifier / Site Tag
campus_id.description: Default campus ID override if not resolved via device location (e.g., CAMPUS-WEST-HIGH)

probe_interval_seconds.title: Synthetic Probe Cadence (seconds)
probe_interval_seconds.description: Frequency in seconds for running synthetic sweeps and Wi-Fi RF telemetry reports

stun_servers.title: WebRTC STUN / Media Testing Servers
stun_servers.description: List of STUN URIs used for latency, jitter, packet loss, and MOS scoring

synthetic_http_targets.title: Synthetic Diagnostic Target Endpoints
synthetic_http_targets.description: List of district web applications to monitor via Resource & Navigation Timing APIs

category.title: App Category (e.g., LMS, Testing, Identity, SaaS)

enable_webrtc_probing.title: Enable WebRTC Quality & MOS Diagnostic
enable_webrtc_probing.description: Periodically evaluate WebRTC media channel latency, jitter, and MOS score via offscreen document

enable_offline_buffer.title: Enable Offline IndexedDB Buffer
enable_offline_buffer.description: Cache telemetry locally when Wi-Fi is roaming or disconnected and replay to CMP upon reconnection

max_offline_records.title: Max Offline Buffer Records
max_offline_records.description: Maximum telemetry events buffered in IndexedDB before FIFO eviction
